Hell RPG v0.1.2.3 development asset notes

This development pass uses user-supplied LPC/OpenGameArt-derived Goblin, Spider, Golem,
Adobe-2, Cave3 and revised Workshop art plus already-preserved project source assets.

The Wolf PSD is intentionally not a runtime asset in v0.1.2.3: its source atlas is irregular
and requires a clean, verified export/normalization pass before gameplay integration.

Additional Arming Sword material palettes, Imp variants and 4-season vegetation/pines were
harvested from the project's previously organized LPC source library.

The user authorized development use without completing the final attribution pass now.
Do not treat this note as final licensing clearance. Exact per-asset authors, license choices,
source URLs and required attribution text remain a release-readiness task before any
commercial/App Store/Play Store distribution.
